Project Coordinator - Modular - Data Center

We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.

Who We Are

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

THE MODULAR TEAM

Modular solutions by CEI anticipate and solve ongoing problems for data center operators. Our proven, factory-built and tested data center infrastructure products bring deployments online faster, more reliably, and with less risk than conventional methods.

About The Role

We're seeking a Project Coordinator ready to be on the front lines of a project, giving daily support to field, project management, and customer teams. This role regularly communicates with field and safety professionals ensuring proper the flow of information such as tracking payroll times for the Production team and processing all new hire enrollment documentation. The Coordinator will assist in WO processing and proposal, bid presentation, change orders, submittals, and RFI & RFD document processing. Other responsibilities include maintaining and updating job files and controlled forms/logs. You’ll provide coordination and administrative support for project managers including tracking schedule, setting up meetings and organizing travel and catering.

Tracking PM schedule, set-up meetings, travel, catering, etc.
Communicate with Field and Safety professionals. Project Coordinators on PV sites is to track Payroll times for Production and process all New Hire Enrollment docs.
Maintaining and updating job files, controlled forms/logs
WO Processing on PV site, Project Coordinator would assist with proposal, bid presentation, change orders, submittals, RFI & RFD document processing

About You

You have a love for order and organization. Working in a fast-paced environment is familiar, and you are flexible and able to adjust to changing situations. You are a natural when it comes to communication and can be seen as “the glue that holds a project together.” You have exceptional communication, writing and organizational skills. Most of all, you're passionate about upholding Cupertino Electric's values of integrity, safety, excellence, innovation, and people, learning relevant aspects of the business, and being an asset to your team.

Excellent communication, written, and organizational skills.
Adaptable and flexible paired with critical thinking and reasoning skills.
Strong understanding of software such as Zoom to manage online group presentations and calls.
Solid experience with Microsoft Office Suite – Word and Excel.

What You Will Gain

As a Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in the operations of a construction project. You will interact and engage with our project teams and field personnel – allowing you to get an understanding of the partnership that takes place behind-the-scenes to ensure the success of a project. Furthermore, you will make an impact by coordinating multiple aspects of a project in a fast-paced and challenging work environment. You will learn to communicate with different levels within the organization by working closely with different teams. Here at Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI), we are committed to fostering an environment where you can collaborate with skilled colleagues who have diverse expertise and backgrounds.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify.

Education:
High school diploma or GED required; College Degree preferred.

Licensure/Certifications:
None required.

Experience:
Three (3) years of experience required in a support role in the construction industry.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

CEI will never ask for any money or financial information from applicants during the hiring process. To learn more about "job scams" how to avoid them, click here.

Role
: Supply Chain Data Analyst

Team
: Supply Planning

: Individual Contributor, P3

: 2-5+

Overview

The Supply Chain Data Analyst plays a key role in supporting global supply planning decision-making through data, reporting, and process improvement initiatives. This role partners with the supply planning team to develop scalable reporting solutions, deliver actionable analysis, and improve the quality and accessibility of supply chain data.

This position is highly project-based and will contribute to initiatives that span inventory health, supply planning, ERP processes, reporting automation, KPI development, and business intelligence. The ideal candidate is technically curious, analytically rigorous, and capable of independently solving ambiguous business problems.

What You'll Do

Analytic and Reporting Duties

Design, build, and maintain Tableau dashboards and reporting solutions for Supply Planning and other Supply Chain teams.
Develop and maintain SQL-based reporting layers to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Partner with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into scalable data solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analysis related to inventory, supply planning, fulfillment, and product availability.
Validate data quality and investigate discrepancies across reporting systems.

Data & Process Improvement

Assist in developing and maintaining data models and reporting assets using Snowflake.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and improve business processes through analytics.
Document business logic, KPI definitions, and data lineage to improve reporting transparency and consistency.
Support testing and validation of new reporting enhancements and data products.
Contribute to cross-functional initiatives involving ERP processes, planning systems, and analytics tools.

Business Partnership

Collaborate closely with Supply Planning team to understand business challenges and provide data-driven recommendations.
Communicate analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support prioritization and execution of analytics projects aligned to supply chain objectives.
Serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders by balancing business context with analytical rigor.

Who You Are

Problem Solver: You enjoy tackling complex and ambiguous problems, breaking them into manageable components, and identifying practical solutions.
Curious: You naturally ask "why" and are motivated to understand how systems, processes, and data connect.
Self-Sufficient: You can independently research, troubleshoot, and work through challenges while knowing when to ask for support.
Collaborative: You enjoy partnering with stakeholders across business and technical teams and can build strong working relationships.
Communicator: You can clearly explain analytical findings, technical concepts, and business impacts to diverse audiences.
Detail Oriented: You care deeply about data quality, accuracy, and creating solutions that stakeholders can trust.
Continuous Learner: You are excited to expand your knowledge of supply chain operations, analytics, and technology platforms.

Experience You Bring

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Operations, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, supply chain analytics, or a related role.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience developing dashboards and visualizations using Tableau.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience analyzing large datasets and translating findings into business recommendations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

Experience using Snowflake.
Experience with dbt or modern data transformation tools.
Experience supporting supply chain, inventory, planning, operations, or ERP processes.
Familiarity with Python, Power Query, or additional analytics tools.
Experience gathering business requirements and supporting cross-functional projects.

: $91,600 - $103,050 USD Annual

Patagonia offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement and leave of absence plans. Benefit plans may vary slightly depending on the nature of your employment.

This position is Hybrid, with a standard schedule of Tuesday - Thursday on-site and remote work on other days. Occasional additional office visits may be required for team events or critical meetings.

Description

Your Role

Use your passion for service and attention to detail to help the Gensler team bring designs to life.  As a Project Coordinator, you will be responsible for supporting the development of design/construction documents, managing communication between designers, engineers, clients, and contractors to help ensure projects are delivered efficiently. Supports the project team in all phases of design and construction. You're at the heart of your studio’s projects and the soul that keeps your projects moving forward.  

What You Will Do

Support architectural and interiors projects from Start-Up through Close-Out by consistently providing a high level of customer service to Gensler staff, clients, vendors, business partners and guests while at times, being the client interface.

Planning: Prioritizing work and ensuring deadlines are met. 
Communication: Managing daily communications with internal and external parties.
Project Tasks: Proposal letters, opening project numbers, project start up process, consultant letters of agreements and work authorizations, team org charts, package preparations & shipping/mailing, QA/QC project administrative documents, print coordination, copying/scanning, and cloud-based file sharing.
Monitoring: Maintenance of various spreadsheets (contracts, work authorizations, consultant work authorizations, sketch logs, punch lists, RFIs, Submittals, etc).
Documentation: Creation and maintenance of project directories and logs, accurate project filing, FAST form documents, preparation of meeting agendas and meeting notes, programming data worksheets.
Resource Management: Meeting coordination and virtual meeting set-ups.
Administrative Tasks: Special duties and projects, as assigned or necessary including studio support, coverage of other coordinators and front desk reception.

Your Qualifications

5-10+ years of experience in an administrative capacity preferably within the architecture, construction or engineering industries.  
Bachelor's Degree preferred or equivalent experience.
Ability to effectively prioritize with strong time management skills in a fast-paced environment. 
Superior verbal and written communication skills. 
Highly organized with a strong attention to detail. 
High level of professionalism and strong sense of urgency. 
Ability to work with minimal guidance; Proactive, motivated self-starter. 
Flexibility and ability to handle and manage change effectively and efficiently. 
Intermediate to advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, Powerpoint).
Flexibility and ability to handle and manage change effectively and efficiently. 
The base salary for this position is estimated to be between $36.00 and $43,25 per hour ($75,000 to $90,000 annually), commensurate with experience and qualifications. In addition to a competitive compensation package, Gensler offers annual bonus opportunities, employee ownership through our ESOP program, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development resources designed to support your long-term growth and career success.
Please note that this is a full-time, in-office role based in our San Diego office, with an expectation of onsite presence five days per week.

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. jobs.description:
Description

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities

Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of program or project management experience
2+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data, track program health, and drive decisions
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon experience in an analytical or program management capacity

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams
Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)
